data.body_html:
Marbella's Feria San Bernabé 2030 (11–15 June) is the Costa del Sol's biggest summer kick-off. While the fairgrounds and casetas buzz on land, the real VIP move is escaping the crowds for a private boat party on the Mediterranean. Our fleet in Puerto Banús offers everything from speedy 6-hour charters to full-day luxury cruises — all with skipper, fuel, drinks, and snacks included. Here's your no-nonsense guide to booking a marbella boat rental feria san bernabe 2030 style.

Why charter a boat during Feria San Bernabé?

The feria draws thousands to Marbella's streets, restaurants, and beach clubs. A boat gives you a private floating base: anchor off Cala del Faro or Cabopino, swim in calm coves, and return to Puerto Banús when the party peaks. No queues, no noise, no hassle.

Our fleet: boats for every party size

We operate 17 vessels from Puerto Banús. For the feria, these are the most popular:

  • Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) – €749/2h, €2,299/8h
  • Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) – €749/2h, €2,299/8h
  • Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) – from €4,719/4h (includes free jet ski)
  • Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax) – pricing on request

All prices include skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and 21% IVA. No surprises.

What's included: the full list

Every charter covers: licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish VAT. You can bring extra food, decorations, or your own playlist. Just ask about Bluetooth or AUX connections.

Best routes for a Feria boat party

From Puerto Banús, head east to Cala Cortés and Cala del Faro — two rocky coves perfect for swimming and photos. Or go west towards Estepona and the Punta de la Doncella beach. For a longer trip, sail to Sotogrande (about 1 hour). Your skipper knows the best spots for calm water and sunset views.

How to book your Feria San Bernabé 2030 charter

For more details on our full fleet, visit our Marbella boat rental hub.

Frequently asked questions

What is Feria San Bernabé 2030?

Feria San Bernabé is Marbella's annual summer fair, honouring the city's patron saint. In 2030 it runs 11–15 June. Expect live music, fairground rides, casetas (traditional tents), and a vibrant atmosphere in the town centre and along the Golden Mile.

Can I rent a boat during Feria San Bernabé 2030?

Yes. Our fleet operates from Puerto Banús throughout the feria. Boats like the Astondoa 40 (€749/2h) or the Mangusta 80 (from €4,719/4h) are popular for daytime parties or sunset cruises. Book early — demand spikes during the fair.

How many people can join a boat party?

Capacity varies by boat. Smaller vessels like the Dubhe (8m) take 5 guests; the Azimut 39 takes 11; the Mangusta 80 and Ferretti 94 take 12. All prices include the skipper, so you can focus on the party.

What is included in the rental price?

Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). No hidden fees.

Can I bring my own food and decorations?

Yes. You're welcome to bring your own party supplies, decorations, and food. We provide the drinks and snacks listed above. Just let us know in advance if you need extra coolers or storage.

What time do charters depart?

All boats depart from Puerto Banús. Standard slots are 10:00–12:00, 12:00–14:00, 14:00–16:00, 16:00–18:00, and 18:00–20:00. For longer rentals (8-hour), we can customise the schedule. Sunset cruises are especially popular during the feria.

How do I book for Feria San Bernabé 2030?

Contact us via WhatsApp for availability, pricing on specific boats, and to secure your date. We recommend booking at least 2–4 weeks ahead for the feria period.

What if the weather is bad on my booked day?

Safety comes first. If the skipper deems conditions unsafe, we'll reschedule at no extra cost or offer a full refund. Marbella enjoys 300+ sunny days a year, so cancellations are rare.
